# Research Guides at Williams College Libraries

> Comprehensive research guide platform providing course-specific resources, subject guides, and access to academic databases for Williams College students and faculty.

Williams College Libraries maintains an extensive collection of research guides organized by course and subject area, supported by professional librarians and integrated with the college's academic programs. The platform serves as a central hub for discovering databases, primary sources, and discipline-specific research resources.

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [Home - Research Guides at Williams College Libraries](https://libguides.williams.edu): Homepage for Williams College Libraries research guides directory
- [A-Z Databases](https://libguides.williams.edu/az.php): A-Z directory of academic databases and research tools at Williams

## Course-Specific Research Guides

- [COMP 216: Folk and Fairy Tales](https://libguides.williams.edu/comp216): COMP 216 course research guide for folk and fairy tales analysis
- [ARTS 225: Video Ecologies](https://libguides.williams.edu/ARTS225): ARTS 225 course research guide for video ecologies and visual studies
- [ECON 255: Econometrics](https://libguides.williams.edu/econ255): ECON 255 course guide for econometrics research and data analysis
- [ECON 230: The Economics of Health and Healthcare](https://libguides.williams.edu/econ230): ECON 230 course guide for health economics research and resources
- [ECON 377: The Economics of Innovation](https://libguides.williams.edu/econ377): ECON 377 course guide for innovation economics research
- [REL 241: History of Sexuality](https://libguides.williams.edu/rel241): REL 241 course guide for history of sexuality research resources
- [PSYC 404: Research Methods and Bias Evaluation](https://libguides.williams.edu/psyc404): PSYC 404 course guide with bias evaluation and citation resources
- [PHLH 351: Racism in Public Health](https://libguides.williams.edu/phlh351): PHLH 351 course guide for racism in public health research
- [GERM 243: Machines in Art and Film](https://libguides.williams.edu/germ243): GERM 243 course guide for machines in art and film studies
- [HIST 158: North of Jim Crow, South of Freedom](https://libguides.williams.edu/hist158): HIST 158 guide to primary sources on African American history

## Specialized Resource Guides

- [Streaming Videos - Platforms & Features](https://libguides.williams.edu/streaming-videos): Comparison of streaming video platforms and features available
- [How to Find Video Games](https://libguides.williams.edu/video-games): Guide to finding video games in Williams College Libraries collection
